problem: A governance/control-plane-only merge started Production Source Snapshot, Production Release Readback and canonical production readback because several non-runtime paths were outside workflow-level paths-ignore.
root_cause: Production trigger ownership was based on an incomplete ignore list. AGENTS.md, brain/policies/**, tools/delivery/** and the targeted-route verifier are control-plane/test surfaces, but they were treated as production-bearing at the GitHub push trigger boundary.
fix: Exclude those control-plane-only paths from both production workflow push triggers while retaining PR Required validation and browser/automation regression coverage.
failed_approaches: Relying on downstream scope classification after a production workflow had already started.
Treating every tools/** or governance metadata change as potentially deployable without path ownership.
